source: فرهنگ املایی خطّ فارسی (۱۳۹۴)؛ همۀ ترکیب‌های نیم‌فاصله‌دار و پیوستۀ فرهنگ؛ رنگ با شمارش ویکی‌پدیای فارسی (scripts/lists/build_compounds.py)
note: entries: chosen in 1.3.1 (red). more: [spaced, to (0: with ZWNJs, 1: joined), page, kind (1 = can also be two words: yellow; 2 = the book's form), suffixes that make it two words, suffixes that make it a verb] Pruned (1.6.4, scripts/lists/prune_phrases.py): yellow pairs of a number and a noun that running text writes apart nearly always; the lexicalised ones kept (1.6.5). Dropped (1.6.5): pairs the farhang lists that running text uses as a noun with its ezafe nearly always («زبان اصلی»، «سال مرگ»).
